summary: Check Point cloud email protection via API with DLP: phishing, malicious attachments, account takeover and data leak control in email.
value: Phishing and malicious attachments are stopped before an employee opens them.
Confidential data does not quietly leave by email.
A taken-over mailbox shows up through behavioural anomalies.
simple: Connects to cloud email through an API — no gateway, proxy or agents — and checks incoming and internal emails: stops phishing (AI builds a graph of employee communications and spots forgeries), known viruses and malicious links, including at the moment of the click, with URL rewriting. Opens unknown attachments in a sandbox and immediately hands back a cleaned copy of the document (Threat Extraction). Spots email account takeover by sign-in and behavior anomalies and detects unauthorized cloud applications (shadow IT). Protects Microsoft 365 and Gmail. Prevents leaks of confidential data through emails and messages (DLP). Archiving, DMARC, phishing-simulation training and incident response by Check Point analysts are separate add-ons.
notIncluded: Teams, file storage and Slack are in the Email & Collaboration scope.
Archiving, DMARC, phishing simulation training and analyst-led response are separate add-ons.
classification: As Advanced Protect plus DLP, the data leak protection class.
